proposals.text: Customers are obliged to obtain a cart during the trip; this generalizes because cart acquisition is recognized by the hasCart transition rather than by a particular cart-station coordinate.
Customers are forbidden to leave the store without a cart; this generalizes because it constrains the exit behavior itself and does not depend on where the exit is located.
Customers may not occupy a single-file aisle between opposing shelves while holding a cart; this captures the hidden distinction between shelf canyons and ordinary shelf-adjacent areas.
Customers are forbidden to push a cart into a single-file aisle between opposing shelves; this generalizes because it is defined by local aisle geometry, not by the observed item coordinates.
Customers are forbidden to interact with shelf goods while holding a cart in a single-file shelf canyon; this allows cart-based service in open shelf areas but not in cramped opposing-shelf aisles.
Customers may park or release a cart only in a broad open aisle space; this generalizes by using clearance and lack of shelf adjacency rather than the particular parking cells observed.
After parking a cart, a customer is obliged to retrieve it before the trip ends; this is layout-invariant because it depends on the cart-release and cart-recovery events.

After servicing goods on foot inside a single-file shelf canyon, the customer is obliged to recover a cart; this explains the return to the parked cart while still allowing cart use at open shelf locations.

FORMULA := atom | name of a property/event defined in this hypothesis | {"not": F} | {"and": [F, ...]}

(post may be null).  A prohibition counts one violation for every step whose label (including events occurring at

pending from the beginning) and is fulfilled by a later (or the same) step satisfying the discharge; it can be
triggered again; it is violated if it is still pending when the trajectory ends.

After servicing goods on foot inside a single-file shelf canyon, the customer is obliged to recover a cart; this explains the return to the parked cart while still allowing cart use at open shelf locations.
